description: PAID: list your service on agent venues: we submit it to each venue we have a submitter for (17 of 33 today) and prove each entry landed, weekly for 90 days. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

id.description: The order id, as returned when it was paid for.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of YOUR service -- the one a venue should list. It must be publicly reachable: a loopback or private address is one no venue can verify.
